description: This file contains a test suite for Cosmos DB reminders in the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes setup, test methods for inserting and reading reminder rows, performance benchmarks, and utility functions related to reminder table operations, specifically in a Cosmos DB context.

classes.name: ReminderTests_Cosmos_Standalone
classes.description: A test class that executes unit and performance tests for Cosmos DB reminder table operations within Orleans.

methods.name: Reminders_AzureTable_InsertRate
methods.description: Performs insertion rate benchmarking by inserting multiple reminder entries into the Cosmos Reminder table.

methods.name: Reminders_AzureTable_InsertNewRowAndReadBack
methods.description: Tests inserting a single reminder row and then reading it back to verify correct storage.

methods.name: TestTableInsertRate
methods.description: Executes multiple upsert operations to measure insert throughput and logs the rate.

methods.name: NewReminderEntry
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ReminderEntry with randomized and fixed properties.

methods.name: NewClusterId
methods.description: Generates a unique cluster identifier string for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAllRows
methods.description: Reads all reminder rows from the specified reminder table.
